instruction: Turn right. Go forward. Turn right at doorway. Go forward. Turn right again. Go forward and stop.
reason: The instruction requires ordered right turns separated by forward travel, including a turn at a doorway, followed by stopping. S1 approaches O3, S2–S3 advance along the cream-walled passage toward the circular foyer, and S4 makes a sustained clockwise bend from northeast toward east while approaching O14 beside the stairs. S5 continues toward the O14 threshold and the small rounded space beyond; F60 and F64 show O15 farther ahead, without evidence that the route has passed a required stopping location or committed to an incompatible branch. The starting heading and exact doorway-to-turn correspondence remain insufficiently specified to establish a missed or opposite turn, so the extended prefix does not overturn the earlier no-deviation finding. No explicit STOP is supplied, and this verdict does not establish completion.
